title: Design of a 2-Ton Mobile Scissor Lift Power Screw
subject: PCC303-MEC

courseOutcome.statement: Design power screws, scissor lifting mechanisms, and power transmission elements by applying kinematics, torque, efficiency, stress analysis, and self-locking criteria for safe industrial operation.

client: Industrial Material Handling Division — Mobile Scissor Lift Mechanism Design

tasks.title: Understand Mobile Scissor Lift and Power-Screw Drive Application
Identify Mobile Scissor Lift and Power-Screw Components
Analyse Scissor Kinematics and Peak Horizontal Power Screw Force
Establish Engineering Design Data and Scissor Lift Parameters
Determine Screw Geometry, Core/Mean Diameters, and Helix Angle
Calculate Virtual Friction Angle and Thread Friction Torque
Calculate Mean Collar Diameter and Thrust Bearing Friction Torque
Determine Total Operating Torque, Overall Efficiency, and Drive Requirement
Evaluate Self-Locking Condition, Lowering Safety, and Fail-Safe Holding
Stress Analysis (Direct Compressive, Torsional Shear, Combined) and FOS Verification
2-Ton Mobile Scissor Lift Power Screw Design & Analysis Report
